title: The duplexity of insulin: The integrated bioinformatics analysis and machine learning identified key genes for type 2 diabetes.
authors: Gao, Nan; Chen, Xiteng; Yang, Jun; Jiang, Yuanfeng; Bu, Shaochong; Bai, Xiaomei; Kou, Zhenyu; Li, Chunjun; Tian, Fang
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过RNA-seq和机器学习识别T2DM胰岛素治疗相关关键基因及转录因子网络，但核心是基因表达与临床表型关联，未涉及蛋白质-DNA三维互作建模或结合机制，仅转录因子网络分析为浅层统计，与本课题TF-DNA互作建模方向关联微弱。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Insulin therapy is still the most important treatment for T2DM, but the discussion about whether insulin brings more benefits or harms to T2DM patients has not stopped. Therefore, we used high-throughput RNA sequencing to investigate the role of insulin in T2DM and its molecular changes. METHOD: We collected peripheral blood samples from 16 patients with T2DM, and performed RNA-seq on peripheral blood mononuclear cells. Bioinformatics analysis and machine learning were uesd to identify the key differential genes and transcription factor networks. In addition, we performed the flow cytometry and staining to observe ROS level and endothelial-monocyte adhesion in PBMCs of both groups. RESULTS: A total of 529 differential genes were identified by bioinformatics analysis. 8 genes were identified as key genes, among which IL-6 had high importance in the random forest model. In transcription factor analysis, IL-6, RETN, CTSG and ELANE have abundant transcriptional regulatory relationships. Flow cytometry showed that ROS production, phagocytosis, leukocyte adhesion in insulin treatment group were lower than that in non-insulin treatment group. CONCLUSION: Insulin therapy is bidirectional, it can cause islet B cell damage and vascular complications, but also can reduce the level of inflammation and oxidative stress.
abstract_zh: 背景：胰岛素治疗仍是2型糖尿病（T2DM）最重要的治疗方法，但关于胰岛素对T2DM患者是带来更多益处还是危害的讨论从未停止。因此，我们利用高通量RNA测序来研究胰岛素在T2DM中的作用及其分子变化。方法：我们收集了16名T2DM患者的外周血样本，并对外周血单核细胞进行了RNA-seq。采用生物信息学分析和机器学习来识别关键差异基因及转录因子网络。此外，我们进行了流式细胞术和染色，以观察两组外周血单核细胞（PBMCs）中的活性氧（ROS）水平和内皮-单核细胞黏附。结果：通过生物信息学分析共鉴定出529个差异基因。其中8个基因被确定为关键基因，在随机森林模型中IL-6具有较高重要性。在转录因子分析中，IL-6、RETN、CTSG和ELANE具有丰富的转录调控关系。流式细胞术显示，胰岛素治疗组的ROS产生、吞噬作用、白细胞黏附均低于非胰岛素治疗组。结论：胰岛素治疗具有双向性，它可能导致胰岛B细胞损伤和血管并发症，但也能降低炎症水平和氧化应激。
